fair.title: Fairness
fair.lead: Every outcome of the season is fixed in advance by a chain of seeds, and nobody, us included, can pick one. Any round can be checked right here, in your browser.
fair.unavailable: The published chain is unavailable right now.
fair.how1: Before the season fair-roll takes a secret root and builds a chain backwards: every link is the SHA-256 of the next one.
fair.how2: The first link, seed₀, is published together with the public seed: the value of a future round of the drand randomness beacon, which nobody knew then.
fair.how3: The number of round k is HMAC-SHA256 keyed with seedₖ over “public seed:k:attempt”; the first 4 bytes modulo 15, dropping the tail that 15 does not divide.
fair.how4: After the spin seedₖ is revealed. SHA-256(seedₖ) must equal seedₖ₋₁, and the number must come out the same.
fair.manualLead: Paste the values from anywhere: nothing is sent, the check runs in this page.
fair.previousSeed: Seed of the previous round (seed₀ for round 1)
fair.linkOk: The seed is the next link of the chain: SHA-256(seed) is the previous seed.
fair.linkBad: The seed is NOT the next link: SHA-256(seed) differs from the previous seed.
fair.match: It matches the result the round showed.
fair.mismatch: It does NOT match the published result, {number}.
fair.notRevealed: Round {round} is not revealed yet: wait until it spins.
fair.failed: The round could not be loaded. Try again.
fair.invalid: Seeds are 64 hexadecimal characters; the round is a whole number from 1.
